blockers.description: Official v4.3.1 document bodies and per-page content hashes are not retained.
Generated Sphinx/API documentation has not been reproduced from the exact release.
Rolling-site statements and documented command conflicts are not resolved into the exact v4.3.1 source authority.

phonopy-exact-document-tree-inventory.title: Phonopy v4.3.1 complete documentation-tree metadata inventory

limitations: The exact source-document inventory does not establish the installed phonopy version, calculator executable behavior, force identity, numerical convergence, or scientific acceptance.

External raw identity is the SHA-256 of canonical sorted git ls-tree -r receipt lines '<mode> <object_type> <object_id>\t<path>\n' for every inventory entry; the local inventory JSON is metadata evidence only and contains no official document body bytes.
The inventory identity binds the exact pre-migration catalog bytes as migration metadata; it does not identify any upstream document body.

document-bodies-not-retained.description: Only exact Git path and object metadata are retained; documentation bodies remain external.

rendered-build-not-replayed.description: The Sphinx/API build and generated command-reference surface have not been reproduced from the exact v4.3.1 release.

rolling-site-drift-unresolved.description: The current rolling website may describe versions newer than v4.3.1; rolling pages are not normalized into the exact-release authority.
